reviewItem.question: Does "When using the Kafka operand and upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older, make sure the `UseStrimziPodSets` feature gate is enabled and `StrimziPodSet` resources…" mean a change to feature-gate:strimzi|name=UseStrimziPodSets (deprecated)?

proposed.statement: The UseStrimziPodSets feature gate is deprecated; environments upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older must enable it and use StrimziPodSet resources before upgrading.
